duplicate.title: Confirm Duplicate Action
duplicate.subject: Subject: Thank you and appreciation for your innovative contribution
paragraphsBefore: We thank you for your valuable initiative and for sharing your idea through the Sadeem platform, and we value your keenness to contribute to developing the work and raising the level of innovation in the organization.

After reviewing the idea, it became clear to us that it significantly intersects with an idea previously proposed on the platform, which reflects your high awareness and direction towards the same strategic priorities of the organization.
Based on our belief that innovation is a collective effort, we are pleased to invite you to be an active contributor to the development of this idea, whether through:
bullets: Or contributing your ideas and expertise to improve it
Or providing guidance and mentorship to the work team
paragraphsAfter: We believe that your value lies not only in the idea, but in your continuous role in creating impact.
Thank you again, and we look forward to your continued outstanding contributions on our journey towards innovation.

link_project.title: Link Idea to Project
link_project.subject: Subject: Opportunity to develop your idea through collaboration and integration
paragraphsBefore: We thank you for your valuable initiative and for sharing your idea through the Sadeem platform, and we value your contribution to supporting the journey of innovation within the organization.

After reviewing your idea, it became clear that it integrates with other ideas proposed on the platform, which opens the way to merge these efforts into a more comprehensive and impactful innovative project.
Based on our belief that the greatest innovations arise from teamwork, we are pleased to invite you to participate in a joint coordination session with related idea owners, with the aim of:
bullets: Maximizing the expected impact of the project
paragraphsAfter: We believe that your idea represents an important part of this integration, and that your contribution will play a pivotal role in the success of the project.
You will be contacted soon to schedule the session, and we look forward to a fruitful collaboration that contributes to achieving a greater innovative impact.

execution_plan.title: Idea within Execution Plan
execution_plan.subject: Subject: Thank you and appreciation for your innovative contribution
paragraphsBefore: We thank you for your valuable initiative and for sharing your idea through the Sadeem platform, and we value your keenness to contribute to developing work and strengthening the culture of innovation within the organization.

We are pleased to inform you that after reviewing your idea, it turned out to be part of one of the projects or initiatives currently being implemented within the organization, which reflects how much your vision aligns with our strategic directions and implementation priorities.
Based on our belief in the importance of involving idea owners in the implementation journey, we welcome your joining as an active contributor through:
bullets: Following up on the project associated with your idea
Or contributing to its development and improving its outputs
Or presenting your opinions and experience to support the work team
paragraphsAfter: We believe that innovation is not limited to proposing the idea, but extends to participating in achieving it on the ground.
Thank you again for your valuable contribution, and we look forward to your continued giving in supporting the journey of innovation.

evaluation.title: Idea Evaluation
evaluation.direct_note_text: This idea may need additional clarification or redesign before approval.
evaluation.click_to_compare: Click to compare this evaluation on the chart
evaluation.bias_dashboard_description: Observe the behavior of the evaluators, their bias tendencies, and the consistency of evaluations across the evaluation team.
evaluation.bias_comparison_description: This chart compares the selected evaluator against the average team rating and the AI ​​rating.
evaluation.bias_metrics_explanation: Bias is measured against the team's average rating for evaluated ideas.

creativity.label: Creativity
creativity.description: The degree of originality and novelty of the idea compared to traditional or existing solutions.

need.label: Need/Demand
need.description: The extent to which the target group or organization needs to apply this idea.

feasibility.label: Feasibility
feasibility.description: The feasibility of implementing the idea in practice using current resources.

sustainability.label: Sustainability
sustainability.description: The ability of the idea to continue and bring positive impact in the long term.

impact.label: Institutional Impact
impact.description: The extent to which the idea contributes to improving the organization's performance or operational efficiency.

alignment.label: Strategic Alignment
alignment.description: The extent to which the idea aligns with the strategic goals and vision of the organization.

risk.label: Risk Mitigation
risk.description: The extent to which the idea contributes to addressing or reducing risks faced by the organization.

reputation.label: Institutional Reputation
reputation.description: The extent to which the idea contributes to enhancing the mental image and general reputation of the organization.

footnotes.strict: Strict evaluators rate below the team average.
footnotes.generous: Generous evaluators rate above the team average.
footnotes.balanced: Balanced evaluators rate close to the team average.

screens.snapshot_desc: The platform is now populated with real test data, and all proposed graphics appear within the design itself.
screens.outcomes_desc: Decision categories after evaluation, including viable, redesign, non-viable, and in-plan ideas.

intelligence_tab.commentary_text: The data has been populated so that the platform looks complete and full of ideas, and Quick Actions have also been added below the main menu as requested.

commentary.text:
The data indicates a notable concentration of AI and customer experience ideas, reflecting clear priorities within the organization.
It also shows redundancy in several ideas within the same domains, opening up opportunities to merge and transform them into more impactful initiatives.

It is recommended to focus on ideas with high success probability and work on merging similar ideas to maximize value.

viable.title: Number of Viable Ideas
viable.desc: Ideas scoring 70% and above after evaluation.

redesign.title: Ideas Needing Redesign
redesign.desc: Ideas scoring between 50% and 69%, requiring refinement and coaching.

nonviable.title: Number of Non-Viable Ideas
nonviable.desc: Ideas scoring below 50%, not recommended for progression.

inplan.title: Ideas Already in Plan
inplan.desc: Ideas matching projects already included in the institutional plan.
